eventDetail.scope: Over the last 17 years, ICSE has become the prominent international forum on semiconductor electronics embracing all aspects of the semiconductor technology. The major areas of activity in the development of Semiconductor Electronics solicited and expected at this conference include but are not limited to 5 clusters which are MEMS & Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, IC Design And manufacturing, Material, Process & Product and Special Cluster (includes Internet of Things, Industrial Revolution 4.0, Big data, Data Security, and Artificial Intelligence).
